author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Accepted and Failed logon lines from OpenSSH sshd at LogLevel INFO, forwarded by the host's syslog daemon to the data collector. Each logon goes to Auth.
notes:
Setup:
- Accepted and Failed logon lines come from sshd at LogLevel INFO, forwarded by the host's syslog daemon.

Time:
- The syslog time has no zone, so the parser reads it as UTC; keep the hosts on UTC or change the layout.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the format OpenSSH's authlog() writes.

Known gaps:
- The tenant's built-in sshd parser matches the same lines, and the engine picks one parser per line: in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 the built-in parser took the four logon lines in 17 of 29 Run Tests.
- Expect some sshd lines to keep the built-in mapping.
